Dialogs.Dialog: I think I like this kind of thing...
I kind of like that sort of thing.
Do I look like I'm having fun？ Maybe.
It's kind of fun, I guess.
I feel like I'm about to laugh.
Hehe... This is kind of nice.
Ugh. This is kind of embarrassing...
Wait, hey, you can't do that！
Idiot！ W-Well, it's fine, I guess.
Geez！ What are you trying to do？
I-I'll get mad！ ...Not that I will！
I can't keep a straight face...
I don't know how to react. Geez...
Yeah... I like it, I guess.
I like you so much I think I'm going crazy.
Why is it... my chest is starting to ache...
Can't you tell I don't like it!?
Patting me won't get you anything？
You can keep going a little.
Hey... are you making fun of me？
Getting a little familiar, aren't you？
You think I'm a kid, don't you？
Don't touch me so much. Geez.
Do you want to touch Rinko's hair that much？
Do you like touching my hair？
I only allow it because it's you.
Hehehe... That kind of feels nice.
What kind of brat are you!?
You messed up my hair... Geez, idiot！
Doing this won't make me happy, you know！
Why are you touching my forehead？
What's wrong？ Touching my forehead like that.
Having fun？ Then I guess it's fine？
Mm！ Stop～. It gives me goosebumps.
Geez！ ...You made me make a weird noise！
Hyah!? Geez... I'm weak to that...
Ugh, this is why guys are...
So you like this after all？
You'll be able to tell my heart's pounding.
Ah！ This makes my heart pound...
Your arm's... touching me, you know.
Hey！ ...Do that again and I'll kick you for real！
No！ Even close as we are, that's against the rules！
Link arms？ Hmm, if you insist...
Like this, I don't want to let go...
If you want to get close, then get closer. Here！
I-I'm not blushing. You're the one who's red！
Hehehe. Let's get closer. ...I'm not embarrassed or anything.
Like this, you can really feel it... each other's warmth.
Link arms？ Getting a little familiar！
I'm not in the mood now. We can link arms anytime.
Sorry. I'm not in the mood right now.
My hand？ I'll lend it for a little bit.
Want to hold it？ Okay, but be gentle.
You want to hold my hand, right？ Sure, go ahead.
Holding hands feels like we melt into each other.
You can hold my hand. Rinko doesn't mind either.
...You can hold it a little tighter.
Like this, with our fingers laced... Yeah, I like this.
I'm not in the mood right now.
You can hold it anytime. Next time.
When it's this hot, you don't feel like getting close, huh.
I'm sweaty, so don't touch me much.
Even when it's hot, we end up close, huh.
You want to touch me even when it's this hot？
My hands are cold, you know？ Okay？
Want to get close？ It is cold.
You're not touching anywhere weird, right？
Ah, you just touched me under cover of darkness, didn't you.
Yeah. The dark makes my heart pound.
Ah... hey, what are you doing？
Just because it's dark, you're not thinking weird stuff, are you？
Geez, what are you doing, idiot...
Getting close isn't embarrassing. Since it's dark.
No one's looking. Hehe... What should we do？
Idiot！ You're way too worked up！
...No. Not in a place like this...
Hey, this joke's gone way too far！
You like this kind of thing？
Want to link arms？ ...Well, if it's just arms.
Is your temperature going up？ Or is it just me？
You want to hold hands even in swimsuits？
Pretty forward, aren't you. Swimsuit freedom？
My hand？ Okay. But maybe it's the swimsuits... it's embarrassing.
Holding hands？ This might be more embarrassing than with clothes on.
No. No getting all clingy here！
Let's not. We'd look like an idiot couple.
...Let's do it when it's a bit cooler.
...Your face says you wish I'd worn a sexier swimsuit.
Are you looking at the swimsuit？ Or my legs？
Don't look so much. My figure's not great...
Why are you looking？ It's embarrassing.
Don't stare at me like that！
Rinko doesn't have a great figure anyway.
...Well, I guess it's okay. Just for today.
Okay. You really want to link arms that much.
Here. Link arms all you want.
...In a kimono, it feels different than usual.
Want to snuggle up to kimono Rinko？
Okay, okay, don't make that hungry face.
In a kimono, maybe quietly leaning close is nicer？
In a kimono... It's a nice mood, huh.
My hand？ If you want to hold it, okay.
Don't let go. Hold it tight.
No. This is fine as is.
No. We don't need to hold hands.
I won't kick. The hem would flip up.
What's wrong？ Staring at my feet.
Wearing these instead of shoes is kind of new.
...Are you looking at the sandals？ Or my feet？
Is it fun just staring at my feet？
If Rinko trips, catch her, okay？
Are you that into Rinko's feet？
Geez... I'm not a kid anymore...
...Stop. It'll make me not want to go home.
...Just a little longer, like this... okay？
You really like touching my hair, huh.
Don't tell me you haven't played enough yet？
...I'd like to stay like this forever... but, you know...
Not letting me go home？ ...That's fine too.
I won't be able to leave...
Hey... no getting embarrassed now, okay？
No. I can't let go of your hand.
Ah... our hands are coming apart.
I want to be with you longer.
You like touching my hair？ I don't mind...
My forehead？ That's an odd one...
My ear... hmm, well, I don't mind.
My arm, okay, okay, go ahead.
Your hand... I don't dislike it, you know？
Touching someone's hair... that's kind of special, right？
My hair's special, just for you.
I like having my hair touched, hehe.
My forehead... Is it fun？ Rinko doesn't mind, though...
My forehead might be really hot, but it's not a fever. You know why, right？
This is bliss... Sure, my forehead.
My ears are sensitive. You're the only one I'd let do this.
Geez, Rinko's ears are hot！ It's your fault for touching them.
Touching my ears feels nice, right？
My arm... You can link it, but don't let go right away.
You don't have to grab my arm like that. I'm staying by your side.
Rinko's arm... keeps calling for you, you know？
When you hold my hand, it's like I get pulled toward you.
Rinko's hand is feeling lonely right now, you know？
Squeeze my hand？ We can stay like this forever, okay？
